pages.text: Trying to hit your foes with your spells can be an ordeal as they could avoid your Magical Fangs with but a single step. With this monocle, you can lock onto nearby foes by pressing the 'Activate Curio' key, allowing you to more accurately hit them with a spell.
Pressing the 'Activate Curio' key while active will change to another nearby foe. Pressing the key while crouching will deactivate the monocle.
